subject: Welcome to the {festival}
body: Right then. You've {days_to_gates} days, £{cash} and a field. Book a headliner first; everything else follows.

subject: Still no headliner
body: Bands won't sign for a festival without a name at the top. Sort the headliner before the rest.

subject: {band_name}: you've got a deal
body: Happy to confirm {band_name} for the {slot} slot at £{fee}, with {merch_pct}% of the merch. See you on the day.

subject: {band_name}: counter-offer
body: Thanks for the offer. {band_name} would do it for £{counter_fee}, the {counter_slot} slot and {counter_merch}% of the merch. Let us know within {days_left} days.

subject: {band_name}: not this time
body: We're going to pass on this one. Do come back to us next year.

subject: {band_name} has moved on
body: We've gone round a few times now, and the band has taken another date. No hard feelings.

subject: {band_name} would love a slot
body: {band_name} are building a following: {listeners} monthly listeners and rising. They'd play an early slot for a modest fee.

subject: Tickets are live
body: Tickets went on sale at £{price}. We'll send you a sales update each week.

subject: Sales update: {sold_pct}% sold
body: {tickets_sold} of {capacity} tickets sold with {days_to_gates} days to go. At this rate we expect about {forecast} people on the day.

subject: Sales are slow
body: We're heading for about {forecast} people, {forecast_pct}% of the field. A bigger name on the bill or a lower price usually helps.

subject: Nearly sold out
body: Only {remaining} tickets left. Make sure your toilets and food can cope with a full field.

subject: Booking confirmed: {units} {facility}
body: We'll deliver {units} {facility} on the morning of the festival. Total: £{cost}.

subject: Mind the queues
body: You've sold {tickets_sold} tickets and have toilets for {capacity_served}. I've seen queues start fights over less.

subject: {festival} lands {band_name}
body: {band_name} will headline this year's {festival}, organisers have confirmed. Tickets from £{price}.

subject: You've an empty slot
body: Your {slot} slot is still empty. An empty stage makes for a quiet field.

subject: Gates open tomorrow
body: Last chance to check the site. Once the gates open, it's too late to add a toilet.

subject: Noise limits for the day
body: A reminder that music must stay under the agreed limit and finish by 11pm. Complaints from the village go to the council, who may fine you.

subject: Keeping the village happy
body: We had complaints last year about the music. You can install a sound limiter for £{cost}, agree to finish at 10:30pm, or take your chances.

subject: Sales need a push
body: We're forecasting {forecast} people, {forecast_pct}% of the field. We can drop the price by £{price_cut}, put posters up around the area for £{poster_cost}, or wait and see.
